messages:
Alex: Heads up — planning to merge SDK PR #412 (bump api-client -> v2.3.0). This touches console client and requires a small helm values tweak for runtime. Need a quick sequence so we don't break canary.
Maria: What does v2.3.0 change? breaking? schema changes?
Sam: Console will consume the new client. If it's additive we can toggle behind a flag, but I need the helm env var added so we can opt-in on staging first.
Tanvi: Helm charts: we need chart version bump + an env var in runtime values. Also a couple unit tests are failing in helm-ci right now — I'll look after lunch. If SDK requires a new config var we should add it now.
Jordan: ci-bot: SDK #412: unit ✅, integration ✅, cross-repo-integration 🚫 (api-client mismatch). See job: https://ci.internal/robot/2421
Alex: Ok — proposal:
1) Maria: merge API change to canary branch (v2.3.0 compatible) so both API and SDK can run against canary.
2) Tanvi: update helm chart + values (chartVersion -> 1.14.0, add REDWOOD_USE_V2_CLIENT env) and push chart PR for canary.
3) Merge SDK #412 against canary. Run end-to-end tests.
4) Sam: cut console PR that toggles new client via env var. Rollout canary -> monitor.
If all good, promote canary changes to main in a single window.
Maria: Sounds fine. v2.3.0 is additive: new optional query param and a tiny response field. No DB changes. I'll open a short canary PR in ~30m and tag you all.
Tanvi: I'll make the helm change now — patch snippet below, will file PR in ~40m.
```
runtime:
  env:
    - name: REDWOOD_USE_V2_CLIENT
      value: "false"
chart:
  version: "1.14.0"
```
Sam: After helm PR is up I can prepare console PR that reads REDWOOD_USE_V2_CLIENT and flips on in staging. Will need an approval from @Maria once canary API is merged.
Alex: Timeline wise I propose we do this in the 2pm-4pm merge window today. If helm tests still failing we can shift to tomorrow morning. @ci-bot can you run the cross-repo integration once the canary PRs are up?
Jordan: ci-bot: will run cross-repo integration when PRs target /canary branches. Please add the label `run-cross-integ` to PRs.
Sam: ack — will add label. Also pinging @Tanvi for helm review once she has the PR.
Tanvi: PR created: https://git.internal/helm/charts/pulls/178 — added chart bump and env var. Helm unit CI ran; one lint warning fixed. Marked for review by @Tanvi (self) and @Alex.
Maria: API canary PR open: https://git.internal/api/pulls/621 — depends on nothing else. Please smoke test client against canary once sdk PR targets canary.
Alex: I will rebase SDK #412 onto /canary and request reviews. If we all agree, merge order = API canary -> helm canary -> SDK -> console. I'll handle merge choreography. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll queue console PR to target canary after SDK is green. Will also add a rollback plan in the PR description.
Maria: Approving API canary once integration is green from SDK run.
Tanvi: Approved my helm PR. Will watch canary for any pod env issues.
Jordan: ci-bot: cross-repo integration queued by Alex — job id 5599. Will post results here.
ci-bot: cross-repo job 5599: in progress...
Alex: Thanks everyone — I'll ping again once SDK is rebased and CI passes. If anyone finds a blocker call it out here and we'll pause the window.
Sam: 👍
Maria: 👍
Tanvi: 👍
